more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Calcium silicate is a hydrous or anhydrous material with variable proportions of calcium oxide and silica; food-grade material must be asbestos-free. Its anti-caking role is to reduce the tendency of particles in a food powder to stick together. The specified material is supplied as off-white powder or liquid.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain chewing gum; dairy analogues, including beverage whiteners; vegetable oil pan spray.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA could not assess food-use safety because the toxicology data were insufficient in 2018.
The former shared silicate intake limit was considered obsolete.
